result.markdown: --- title: "[Graph.eccentricity()]{.doc-object-name .doc-function .doc-label .doc-label-method}" body-classes: doc-api-page doc-py-api-page shift-heading-level-by: 0 toc-depth: 3 page-navigation: false html-table-processing: none --- ::: {.doc-subject} Calculate eccentricity for each node in the graph. ::: ::: {.doc-usage-source} Usage [Source](https://github.com/rich-iannone/edgecase/blob/main/python/edgecase/graph.py#L17164-L17230){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} ::: ::: {.doc-signature .doc-Kind.FUNCTION} ```python Graph.eccentricity( attr_name=None, return_dict=False, ) ``` ::: ::: {.doc-text} Eccentricity of a node is the maximum distance from that node to any other reachable node in the graph. It measures how far a node is from the most distant node it can reach. Returns `None` for nodes in disconnected graphs where some nodes are unreachable. ::: ## Parameters {.doc-parameters} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [attr_name]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [str | None]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [None]{.doc-parameter-default} : Name of the node attribute to store eccentricity values. If `None`, uses `eccentricity` as the attribute name. [return_dict]{.doc-parameter-name}[:]{.doc-parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.doc-parameter-annotation} [=]{.doc-parameter-default-sep .op} [[False]{.va}]{.doc-parameter-default} : If `True`, returns a dictionary mapping node IDs to eccentricity values. If `False`, stores values as node attributes and returns the Graph for chaining. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [dict[int, int | None] or Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : If `return_dict=` is `True`: Dictionary mapping node IDs to eccentricity values. Values are `None` for nodes in disconnected components. If `return_dict=` is `False`: Returns self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} The middle node "C" reaches every other node in at most two hops, giving it the lowest (most central) eccentricity, while the two end nodes must each reach two hops further in the opposite direction: ::: {#9285a30a .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_node(label="A") .add_node(label="B") .add_node(label="C") .add_node(label="D") .add_node(label="E") .add_edge("A", "B") .add_edge("B", "C") .add_edge("C", "D") .add_edge("D", "E") ) graph.eccentricity(return_dict=True) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` {3: 2, 1: 4, 5: 4, 4: 3, 2: 3} ``` ::: :::
